description:
The best way to track prices on the products you want. 

- View products and their price history.
- Set price alerts to be emailed when discounts hit.

e.g. 

1. Tell ChatGPT: "@Pricey set a price alert on [product link]".
2. Tell ChatGPT the price you want and where to email you.
3. Done!
